 DOJ Announces Significant Charges Related to Ghost Student Fraud 
 Thursday, October 29, 2026 
 Share 
 Facebook 
 X 
 LinkedIn 
 Email 
 Remote video URL 
 Top officials announced indictments resulting from Operation Ghostbusters, an investigation into a large-scale student loan fraud scheme in which actors created fraudulent FAFSA (federal student loan) accounts using stolen U.S. citizen identities to enroll “ghost students” in educational institutions.
